GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start restrained to find cover. Held up for clear running from passing the 500m before shifting out into clear running approaching the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , long last off poor start 10 Lengths 700m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up , worked to Middle Of Track last 200m and Made Good Ground late # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and restrained to settle at the rear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, made no ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Resaddled on arrival at barriers. Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated the race was not run to suit it, it was under pressure from 600m and proved disappointing. Trainer stated it was up in class and distance, and felt it was not suited to the track opining it was cutting up. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a re-saddle upon arrival at the barriers. When asked to comment on the performance, rdr stated that the race was not run to suit her mount, that the mare was under pressure from the 600m and proved disappointing. Trnr stated that the mare was up in class and distance tonight and felt the horse was not suited to the track, which in his opinion was cutting up. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no apparent abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, Restrained & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths rail turning, around heels Straightening Up , shifted 3 Wide and ran on in Straight hitting Lead 30m from post # ran on x-well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was restrained in the early stages to obtain a position with cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 8th Inside 8 Lengths with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, Hard Ridden Turning for home - # couldn't quicken
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slow out/fair late
Slow Out 2 Lengths , Settled back last rails 8 Lengths 700m, still last and on fence Straightening Up , weaved off fence last 200m and Made Good Ground to grab second spot # ran on solidly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping. Shifted to the outside of heels before being crowded and buffeted near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bucked coming out of barrier and missed the start 2.5 Lengths then taken across and Settled Down last 10 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 6.5 Lengths (still last) turning, Hooked Out widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # Bucked/blew start
Checked 1 length at start and Settled Down 14 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then picked up only a length in Straight # Checked at start

Jumped Ok , Drifted Back Worse than midfield rails 10 Lengths 800m, rider took off at 600m and circled field Four Wide , joined Leaders and looked chance on turn, only peaked last 100m # run peaked 100m
